question: How can I cancel my order?
answer: You can request cancellation before the order is prepared. Open your order details and check whether cancellation is available. Once preparation or delivery has started, cancellation may not be possible.

question: How can I get a refund?
answer: If your order is eligible for a refund, submit a request through the Help section. The refund timeline depends on the payment method and the reason for the request.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: Our demo service supports UPI, debit cards, credit cards, and cash on delivery where available. These are example payment options for our Customers.

question: What should I do if an item is missing?
answer: Please report the missing item through the Help section. Mention the item name and order ID so the support team can review the issue.

question: Why is my order delayed?
answer: An order may be delayed because of traffic, weather, or preparation time. Check your order status for the latest information available in Order Section.

question: How can I apply a coupon?
answer: Enter your coupon code in the offers or checkout section before placing an order. Discounts depend on the coupon conditions.

question: What are the delivery charges?
answer: Delivery charges may depend on distance, order value, and available offers. In a real service, the applicable fee would be displayed before checkout.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Open the Help section of the service to find support options. This college prototype does not connect to a real customer-support team.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: You may be able to update your delivery address before the order is dispatched. Open your order details and check whether address editing is available.

question: What if I receive the wrong item?
answer: Report the issue through the Help section. Include the item you ordered, the item you received, and your order ID.

question: Can I pay using UPI?
answer: UPI is one of the example payment methods supported by our fictional demo service. Actual payment options would depend on the real service.

question: Can I place an order without creating an account?
answer: Guest ordering depends on the service's policies. Please check the sign-in and checkout options in the actual app you are using.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Enter your sample order ID, such as ORD101, in the chat to view its predefined status in this demonstration.

question: What if my order shows delivered but I have not received it?
answer: Check the delivery location and any delivery notifications. If the order is still missing, report the issue through the service's Help section.

question: Can I change my order after placing it?
answer: Order modifications may be possible only before preparation begins. Open your order details to check the available options.

question: What should I do if payment fails?
answer: Check your payment app or bank for the transaction status before trying again. If money was deducted, contact the payment provider or service support for assistance.

question: Why was my order cancelled?
answer: An order may be cancelled because of availability, payment problems, or other service-related issues. Check the cancellation notice or contact the service's support team.

question: Can I schedule an order for later?
answer: Scheduled ordering depends on the service and location. Check whether a scheduling option is available during checkout.

question: How do I report a damaged item?
answer: Report the damaged or poor-quality item through the Help section. Include your order ID and a clear description of the problem.

question: Are delivery charges refundable?
answer: Whether delivery charges are refunded depends on the service's refund policy and the circumstances of the order.

question: How can I use a referral code?
answer: If referral offers are available, enter the referral code in the designated section of the app. Eligibility and rewards depend on the offer terms.

question: Can I get an invoice for my order?
answer: Check your order details or confirmation message for an invoice or receipt. Availability depends on the service's billing features.

question: What happens if a restaurant is closed?
answer: If a restaurant or outlet is unavailable, you may need to select another option. If you have already paid for an affected order, check the order status and contact support.

question: Can I rate my delivery experience?
answer: If the service offers ratings, you can usually submit feedback from the completed order details. Keep your feedback specific and respectful.

question: Is this a real food delivery service?
answer: No. FAQgent AI is a college mini-project prototype. It uses sample FAQs and fictional order records and is not connected to a real food-delivery service.
